items.summary: Delhi Police on Tuesday released the four Hindu Raksha Dal workers it had arrested ~48 hours earlier for the Oct 10 DDU Marg assault on protesters (videos showed them beating a young man and dragging a woman across the street; police had acted suo motu). A viral clip of the release shows supporters — including Hindu Raksha Dal president Pinki Chaudhary — garlanding one accused with flowers, who shouted that 'the cockroaches will be dealt with in the same way again.' Congress accused the state of shielding 'RSS-BJP goons,' citing the police's inaction during the original assault. Lands on the day the Delhi HC hears the hooligans/NSUI plea on attacks against protesters.
items.title: Delhi Police releases the four Hindu Raksha Dal men arrested for the Oct-10 assault on protesters; supporters garland them
